offline_session_invariants: Every offline session is anchored to one exact semantic manifest digest and exact Book canonical/manuscript subject.
Offline work never carries canonical effect and is never auto-applied on reconnect.
If both semantic manifest and Book subject remain exact, the offline delta is eligible only for the normal Book admission path.
If either semantic manifest or Book subject changed, reconnect returns RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and forbids normal automatic admission.
retention_invariants: Book defines the semantic classes that must remain retrievable; CORE owns physical retention execution.
SEMANTIC_BACKUP_SET, PRESERVATION_RECEIPTS and BOOK_LINEAGE are mandatory retained semantic classes.
Retrievability verification and destructive-restore drill are required by the preservation retention policy.
Book physical retention execution is forbidden.
lineage_reentry_invariants: Preservation may emit continuation and reentry anchors bound to the exact semantic manifest and subject.
Lineage/reentry anchors do not grant release, distribution or canonical mutation authority.
provider_namespace_rule: This extension does not define or register a CORE public operation. Physical provider dispatch remains governed by the canonical profile's CORE/P03 REGISTERED_ACTIVE COMMAND requirement.
non_claims: This extension does not merge or canonize the divergent book-eng-009-semantic-recovery-profile-001 branch.
This extension does not register CORE.DURABILITY.BOOK_RECOVERY.v1 or any other conceptual port as a public operation.
This extension does not close the four CORE-owned P19 physical dependencies.
This extension does not make ENG-009 whole-objective complete.
